| `category[is]` | `string` | no | `security` returns only security-trail entries: actions that start with `api_key.`, `webhook_endpoint.`, `gateway_account.`, `integration.`, `mail_transport.`, `team.` or `organization.two_factor.`, and `data.export`. `other` returns all remaining entries.
